§6Crafting Storage§f units are multiblock components of the §6Crafting CPU§f. They hold intermediate ingredients during multistep autocrafting jobs.

Four tiers: §61k§f (1,024 items), §64k§f (4,096), §616k§f (16,384), §664k§f (65,536). Each is a Crafting Unit + matching Storage Component. Place them on the inner walls of the 3x3x3 CPU multiblock.

Without Crafting Storage, any craft requiring intermediate ingredients will fail. Start with 1-2 units of §64k§f and expand to §616k§f once your network grows.

§ePS:§f Pair with a §6Crafting Monitor§f to see real-time intermediate counts. Crafting Storage units are not Storage Cells and cannot hold items from the ME Terminal.
